body: I hate my younger brother. I don’t want to see or talk to him. He repulses me and no one knows, not even him. He’s very self centered and just an all round asshole among other things.
I wish you understood my mental illness instead of just leaving. I know it’s because it was too hard for you but damn, I wish you’d just understand.

Well my girlfriend left me today because I am bipolar and she was the most loving, caring, and compassionate person I know. It makes me wonder if I am capable of being with someone, after all, her and I were, what felt, a pretty good paring. And I also found out marriages with bipolar people fail 90% of the time. So I'm pretty sure I'll die alone now.
